mapper.insert: insert into goodfish_item_prompt (id, item_id, system_prompt, price_prompt, tech_prompt, default_prompt, max_reply_length) values (#{prompt.id}, #{prompt.itemId}, #{prompt.systemPrompt}, #{prompt.pricePrompt}, #{prompt.techPrompt}, #{prompt.defaultPrompt}, COALESCE(#{prompt.maxReplyLength}, #{defaultMaxReplyLength})) on conflict (item_id) do update set system_prompt = COALESCE(excluded.system_prompt, goodfish_item_prompt.system_prompt), price_prompt = COALESCE(excluded.price_prompt, goodfish_item_prompt.price_prompt), tech_prompt = COALESCE(excluded.tech_prompt, goodfish_item_prompt.tech_prompt), default_prompt = COALESCE(excluded.default_prompt, goodfish_item_prompt.default_prompt), max_reply_length = COALESCE(excluded.max_reply_length, goodfish_item_prompt.max_reply_length), update_time = now()
